description: Synthesize procurement, market, and service knowledge from supplied evidence. Optionally extract a provenance-tagged knowledge graph from your supplied sources.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Explicit authorization to send these sources and prior-agent context to the selected inference provider.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical service request.

inputs.description: Original buyer inputs. Service-specific CSV/date/rubric validation and a combined 75,000-character limit also apply.

category.description: Category pack — mro, indirect, it-software, it-hardware or telecom

context.description: Business context and decision needed — Describe the category, organization, geography, constraints, and outcome needed.

documents.description: Source documents and evidence — Paste contracts, spend extracts, supplier proposals, policies, or dated market evidence. Plain text only.

knowledgeGraph.description: Optional source evidence graph — Paste a single-document graph.json export and include its original text in Source documents. Import APIs support explicit source IDs.

paymentInvoiceId.description: A separate confirmed service invoice when payment is required.

name: knowledge
title: Procurement knowledge
